stn_gyra_init.m: Help! You must help me! Please!
r: What is your problem, my little one?

stn_gyra_init_10.m: I am Gyra, Odirath's daughter. My father is the armorer of Stoutford, a very important man.

stn_gyra_init_12.m: I was looking for Lord Bourbon's helmet, when I was surprised by these monsters.

stn_gyra_init_20.m: So I hid here in the storeroom and didn't dare to leave the hiding place.
r: Eh, I will be back soon. Maybe. But ... probably not, no. I hate kids.
Of course I will help you. Just follow me.

stn_gyra_init_50.m: Great! It is so important that Lord Bourbon gets his helmet. Then he will drive out these monsters!

stn_gyra_init_52.m: I started to look in the main house, but maybe we have to search the whole castle.

stn_quest_gyra: Lost girl looking for lost things

stn_quest_gyra.5: The mechanism of the south gate seemed to be broken. Maybe someone in Stoutford could repair it?
stn_quest_gyra.10: The little daughter of Odirath the armorer has been missing for several days now. You offered to help search for her.
stn_quest_gyra.20:
Odirath's daughter Gyra was hidden in the storeroom of the main house of the castle. She was surprised by the raid on the castle and no longer dared to leave her hiding place.
She was looking for Lord Berbane's helmet, which he had forgotten somewhere in the castle.
stn_quest_gyra.30: You offered Gyra to lead her back home safely.
stn_quest_gyra.40: Gyra has the feeling that the helmet is very close.
stn_quest_gyra.60: Once back in Stoutford Gyra knew the way and ran to her father Odirath.
stn_quest_gyra.70: Odirath thanks you many thousand times.
stn_quest_gyra.80: Odirath had repaired the mechanism of the southern castle gate.
stn_quest_gyra.90: Lord Berbane slowly took his helmet. Nevertheless, he remained sitting at the table. He probably needs a few more hours without drinks before he can get back to work. If ever.
stn_quest_gyra.92: Lord Berbane took his helmet. But somehow that does not really satisfy you.
stn_quest_gyra.99: Lord Berbane is singing merrily about his pretended heroic deeds. What a boaster.
stn_quest_gyra.170: Odirath thanked you many thousands of times.
stn_quest_gyra.199: Lord Berbane is singing merrily about his pretended heroic deeds. What a boaster.
